title: Engine Dual Mode Local And Remote Kit Authentication
description: Extend the engine with authentication for remote server kits. Refactor to support two kit modes: local (path-based) and remote (server with accounts and auth). All MCP, REST, GraphQL functionality must work for both. Add auth tokens, login/logout flows, and comprehensive tests.
summary: Extended engine with dual-mode kit support (local + remote). Added 5 auth error classes to compose.py. Added RemoteStore class, auth credential management (login/logout/getAuthToken/getAuthStatus with ~/.compose/auth.json), REST auth endpoints (/auth/login, /auth/logout, /auth/status), MCP auth tools (mcp_login, mcp_logout, mcp_auth_status), start_working_in_remote_kit MCP tool, session mode/source tracking, and updated StoreFactory for remote URIs. All 137 tests pass (65 existing + 72 new comprehensive tests covering auth errors, credentials, RemoteStore CRUD, StoreFactory remote, MCP auth tools, MCP remote kit workflow, REST auth endpoints, and _load_kit_from_remote).
